changes: Redesigned the transcription module with Editory visual identity and responsive layout.
Moved transcription history below the processing area and separated active tasks from completed history.
Added an internal transcript reader view opened from history cards.
Copy action now exports clean readable transcript text without timestamps or metadata.
Search now lives inside the transcript reader and highlights matches.
Reduced the Electron minimum window width for the responsive desktop layout.
known_risks: The UI was validated with static checks and local HTTP routes, but not with a real browser screenshot tool in this environment.
The copy formatting is a presentation-layer heuristic and does not alter stored segments or SRT timestamps.
The silence remover logic was intentionally not changed.
